## Hero and our position

**Eyebrow:** Sustainability · Saudi Arabia, UAE & Qatar

**H1 — Moving people across the Gulf with less impact**

**Answer-first intro:** AB runs chauffeur, bus and coach transport in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar. Our fleet of 440 vehicles runs across the region: 260 in Saudi Arabia, 140 in the UAE and 40 in Qatar. To cut emissions, we have started moving this fleet to hybrid and electric vehicles, with the goal of a fully hybrid and electric fleet by 2030. Alongside that switch, we measure the emissions of every trip and cut empty kilometres. We report progress openly and do not claim results we have not measured.

**Buttons:** \[Ask for a low-emission transport plan\] · \[See our roadmap\]

**H2 — Where we start**

Ground transport is one of the largest sources of emissions in Gulf cities, and our business is moving people by road. We would rather show a real baseline and a dated plan than a badge. Today's starting point \[Confirm each figure with fleet data\]:

- Fleet: 440 vehicles in total, with 260 in Saudi Arabia, 140 in the UAE and 40 in Qatar
- Fleet transition: under way, moving to hybrid and electric vehicles with a fully hybrid and electric fleet by 2030; current hybrid and electric count \[Confirm\]
- Vehicle age: every vehicle in the fleet is a 2025 or 2026 model; buses and coaches meet \[Confirm: Euro / GSO emission standard\]
- Emissions measured since: 2026

## Regulations and national goals we align with

**H2 — Built around the rules where we operate**

AB's plan follows the climate laws and transport targets of each country we operate in, plus the global methods our clients use for their own reporting. The table is the page's reference block; every row links to its source.

| Where        | Rule or target                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | What it means for AB                                                                                                                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Saudi Arabia | Net zero by 2060; 30% of vehicles in Riyadh electric by 2030, as part of a plan to halve the capital's emissions ([The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/road-to-net-zero/2021/10/24/saudi-arabia-wants-30-of-vehicles-on-riyadhs-roads-to-be-electric-by-2030)) | Riyadh is our first city for electric chauffeur cars and the first to get on-site charging                                                |
| Saudi Arabia | EVIQ plans 5,000 fast chargers by 2030 for inter-city travel ([Arab News](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2645170))                                                                                                                                                                  | Electric intercity routes (e.g. Riyadh–Dammam) trialled once the corridor chargers are live                                               |
| UAE          | Federal Decree-Law No. 11 of 2024, in force since 30 May 2025: all private companies, free zones included, must measure and report Scope 1 and 2 emissions to the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment ([Crowe](https://www.crowe.com/ae/news/uae-climate-law))             | AB's UAE entity measures and reports its fleet emissions; the same method is used in KSA and Qatar                                        |
| UAE (Dubai)  | RTA plan for the whole Dubai taxi fleet to be hybrid, electric or hydrogen by the end of 2027 ([The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/uae/transport/2023/02/06/dubai-rta-to-phase-out-petrol-only-taxis-from-its-fleet-by-2027))                                          | Dubai chauffeur fleet moves to hybrid and electric on the same timeline \[Confirm whether RTA rules for limousine operators apply to AB\] |
| Qatar        | Ministry of Transport plan: 100% of public buses electric by Q4 2030, school buses moving to electric by the same date ([MoT Qatar](https://mot.gov.qa/en/land-transport/Qatar-Electric-Bus-Transition-Plan))                                                                     | Doha coach and event fleet follows the national e-bus transition; electric buses sourced locally where available                          |
| Global       | ISO 14083:2023, the international method for quantifying and reporting GHG emissions from passenger and freight transport chains ([ISO](https://committee.iso.org/sites/tc207sc7/home/news/content-left-area/news-and-updates/new-standard-for-transport-ghg-e.html))             | Per-trip and per-passenger-km CO2e figures in client reports follow ISO 14083                                                             |
| Global       | GHG Protocol corporate standard (Scope 1, 2, 3)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | AB reports its own Scope 1 and 2; clients receive the data they need for their Scope 3 (business travel and events)                       |

What we will not do: claim to be "carbon neutral" or "net zero" through offsets alone, or sign up to pledges we cannot report against.

## What we are doing now

**H2 — Practical steps on every trip**

The fastest cuts in road transport come from running vehicles better, before any new technology. These are the steps AB applies or will apply first \[Confirm which are live today\]:

**H3 — Fewer empty kilometres.** The Riyadh control room plans routes and chains trips so vehicles drive less without passengers. Chauffeurs wait at holding points near hotels and venues instead of returning to base between jobs.

**H3 — The right vehicle for the group.** We match vehicle size to passenger numbers. Twelve delegates travel in one coach, not four sedans, and event shuttles run to a timetable built from real arrival data.

**H3 — No idling policy.** Engines stay off while waiting, with a short pre-cooling window before pickup in summer heat. Driver apps and telematics flag long idling so it can be coached.

**H3 — Eco-driving training.** Smooth acceleration and steady speeds are part of the AB Chauffeur Standard. They cut fuel use and give passengers a calmer ride.

**H3 — Newer, cleaner vehicles.** Sedans and SUVs are replaced every \[Confirm: N\] years; buses and coaches meet \[Confirm: Euro V / Euro VI or GSO equivalent\] emission standards. We have started replacing petrol and diesel vehicles with hybrid and electric models, and aim to run a fully hybrid and electric fleet by 2030.

**H3 — Maintenance on schedule.** Correct tyre pressure, clean filters and serviced air conditioning keep fuel use down and reduce breakdowns.

**H3 — Paperless operations.** Digital trip sheets, e-invoices and digital name boards replace printed paper on every job.

## Measuring and reporting

**H2 — We measure before we promise**

Every target on this page depends on knowing our real emissions. AB measures fuel and electricity used per vehicle and per trip, then converts it to CO2e following ISO 14083 and the GHG Protocol.

| What we measure                      | How                                                | Who sees it                         |
| ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Fuel and electricity per vehicle     | Fuel cards, charging records, telematics           | AB management; UAE report to MOCCAE |
| CO2e per trip and per passenger-km   | Distance and energy data per job, ISO 14083 method | Corporate and event clients         |
| Empty km share                       | Dispatch system                                    | Operations team, monthly            |
| Fleet mix (petrol, hybrid, electric) | Fleet register                                     | Published here once a year          |

**H3 — Client emissions reports.** Corporate accounts receive a quarterly report of CO2e from their trips, ready for their Scope 3 business-travel reporting. Event clients receive a post-event transport footprint with the event report \[Confirm launch date\].

**H3 — Annual update.** We publish our fleet mix and total emissions on this page each year, starting with 2026 data. Once our method is stable, we will ask an independent firm to verify the figures \[Confirm\].

## People, safety and community

**H2 — Sustainability includes the people who drive**

- **Road safety:** speed and harsh-braking alerts from telematics, fatigue limits on shift length, and defensive-driving refreshers. We plan to align our road safety management with ISO 39001 \[Confirm\].
- **Fair work:** chauffeurs are employed on written contracts, paid on time, and never charged recruitment fees (see Careers).
- **Heat safety:** rest breaks and shaded, air-conditioned waiting areas for drivers during summer midday hours, in line with each country's heat-protection rules.
- **Local hiring and training:** opportunities for Saudi, Emirati and Qatari nationals in operations and management roles.
- **Responsible suppliers:** every partner fleet signs AB's supplier standard, which covers vehicle emissions, safety and fair treatment of drivers (see Suppliers).

## For clients

**H2 — Lower-emission transport for your company or event**

**H3 — Corporate accounts.** Ask for hybrid or electric vehicles as your default class, where available in your city. You receive a quarterly CO2e report for your business-travel reporting.

**H3 — Events and conferences.** We design the transport plan around fewer, fuller vehicles: shared shuttle loops instead of individual cars, timed waves for arrivals and departures, and electric buses where the venue and city allow. After the event you receive a transport footprint you can include in your event sustainability report.

**H3 — Tenders.** Our sustainability statement, fleet mix and emissions method are available for procurement and ESG questionnaires.

**Button:** \[Ask for a low-emission transport plan\] → opens the event or tender form with "sustainability requirements" pre-ticked.

## FAQs

**H2 — Sustainability questions**

1. **Does AB have electric chauffeur cars?** \[Confirm: Yes, in Riyadh and Dubai, on request / Not yet; our first electric vehicles join the fleet in 2027.\] Ask when you book, and we will confirm availability for your date.
2. **Can you provide electric buses for an event?** Where electric buses and charging are available in the host city, yes. In Doha this is increasingly the norm, in line with Qatar's national e-bus plan.
3. **Can I get a CO2 report for my company's trips?** Yes, for corporate accounts. Reports follow ISO 14083 and show CO2e per trip and in total \[Confirm launch date\].
4. **Is AB carbon neutral?** No. We do not claim carbon neutrality. We are measuring our emissions and cutting them first; any future use of carbon credits will be reported separately and never presented as a substitute for cutting emissions.
5. **How does AB comply with the UAE climate law?** AB's UAE operations measure and report Scope 1 and 2 emissions to the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, as Federal Decree-Law No. 11 of 2024 requires \[Confirm status\].
6. **Can you complete our supplier sustainability questionnaire?** Yes. Send it with your tender, or request our sustainability statement.
